tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The area behind PDF pages in the viewer and organize grid. Never put text directly on it except page numbers in `caption` with `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App chrome: toolbar, tab bar of the active tab, panels, home screen.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Title bar, left sidebar, inactive tabs, hover fill for ghost controls.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs, the floating zoom bar.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: PDF page background and page thumbnails. Stays white in the dark UI theme; only Page dark mode (renderer) changes pages.

tokens.name: paper-dark
tokens.usage: Page background in Page dark mode, matching what the renderer turns white into (luma 255 → 22), shown while tiles load.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between toolbar, sidebar and panels; card outlines. Decorative only — never the only border on a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and checkboxes (3:1 on surface, surface-sunken, surface-raised in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and active icons on surface, surface-sunken, surface-raised, canvas, selected and brand-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, idle toolbar icons, placeholders — on surface, surface-sunken, surface-raised and selected.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Lumora teal. Primary buttons, active tool group, links, current-page outline. As text on surface, surface-sunken, brand-soft and selected.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind brand text: active tool group, info notices.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand or brand-hover fill (primary button label). Never literal white.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected list rows, active toggle icon buttons, selected thumbnails' caption chip.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. At least 5.5:1 on every surface and on canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: lumen
tokens.usage: The Lumora glow — brand accent for the New badge, logo moments, onboarding art. A fill only: never text on light surfaces (2.2:1).

tokens.name: lumen-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for tips and What's new notices; text on it is ink, with a lead phrase in lumen-ink.

tokens.name: lumen-ink
tokens.usage: Accent text on lumen-soft and surface: the lead phrase of a tip or What's new message (6.6:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: on-lumen
tokens.usage: Text on a lumen fill (the New badge).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved, signature valid, OCR done. Always paired with an icon or word. Text on surface and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success notices and badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Unsaved recovery, form uses JavaScript, large file. Text on surface and warning-soft, with an icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (Delete pages, Apply redaction), errors, invalid signature. Text on surface and danger-soft, with an icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error notices and danger badges.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modal dialogs.

tokens.name: text-selection
tokens.usage: Text-selection overlay drawn on PDF pages (paper), both themes.

tokens.name: search-hit
tokens.usage: Find results drawn on PDF pages.

tokens.name: search-hit-active
tokens.usage: The current find result on a page.

tokens.name: hl-yellow
tokens.usage: Highlighter default. Annotation colors are written into the PDF and stay the same in every UI theme; ink on it 13.7:1.

tokens.name: hl-green
tokens.usage: Highlighter option.

tokens.name: hl-blue
tokens.usage: Highlighter option.

tokens.name: hl-pink
tokens.usage: Highlighter option.

tokens.name: hl-orange
tokens.usage: Highlighter option.

tokens.name: hl-purple
tokens.usage: Highlighter option.

tokens.name: pen-black
tokens.usage: Ink, shapes and text-box default. Written into the PDF.

tokens.name: pen-red
tokens.usage: Ink, shapes, strike-out and review markup.

tokens.name: pen-blue
tokens.usage: Ink, shapes and form-fill text.

tokens.name: pen-green
tokens.usage: Ink, shapes and approval stamps.

families.ui: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: The OS UI face, so Lumora feels native and costs nothing to load. Six steps; 13px is the default.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Dialog titles and the home screen section titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pages 3–7 will be moved to a new file.
styles.usage: Default UI text: menus, lists, dialog body, settings.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text; file names in lists.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Tool-group tabs, document tabs, buttons-sm, form labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Thumbnail page numbers, timestamps, badges, status bar.

groups.name: Brand
groups.note: Newsreader (SIL OFL) — a serif drawn for reading on screens. Only for brand moments, never for controls.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home screen greeting, onboarding, website hero.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Empty states, About dialog, onboarding headers.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Keyboard shortcuts, file sizes, Bates numbers, form field names.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Toolbars and lists use space-1 to space-3; panels and dialogs space-4 to space-6.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps inside dense controls; gap between toolbar icon buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap between controls in a row; list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; sidebar item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between PDF pages on canvas.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog body padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Home screen gutters; space between dialog sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Home screen section spacing.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state and onboarding padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, keyboard keys, color swatches' focus box, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, icon buttons, tabs (top corners), menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers, menus, cards on the home screen.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The floating zoom bar, segmented toggles, color swatches.

shadow.note: Shadows only lift things that float over the canvas. Chrome is flat and divided by `line`.

tokens.name: shadow-page
tokens.usage: PDF pages and page thumbnails on canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the floating zoom bar, color pickers.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs over the scrim.

size.note: Fixed sizes of the app frame (desktop). Touch layouts (iPad) scale controls to 44px.

tokens.name: titlebar-h
tokens.usage: Title bar with document tabs.

tokens.name: toolbar-h
tokens.usage: Main toolbar with tool groups.

tokens.name: subtoolbar-h
tokens.usage: Secondary toolbar holding the active group's tools.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, icon buttons.

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons in panels and the zoom bar.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Left sidebar default width (resizable 200–400px).

tokens.name: panel-w
tokens.usage: Right properties panel width.

tokens.name: thumb-w
tokens.usage: Page thumbnail width in the sidebar.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Toolbar icons.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, menus and lists.
